title: Studies in Epistemology/Metaphysics; Epistemology of Disagreement
description: A thorough introduction to the burgeoning research on peer disagreement. Questions include: Should I become less confident on my take on some issue if I learn that my equally informed and capable colleague disagrees with me? How do I decide which expert to trust when experts themselves seem to be in disagreement? What's the rational response to a disagreement involving religious belief? How does the work on rational disagreement relate to political disagreement?
